raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash on CUDA/SM90 supports prefill context parallelism
(`--enable-prefill-cp --cp-strategy interleave`) and decoder SWA bounded replay
(`--enable-decoder-swa-bounded-replay`), and each works on its own. Enabling both
together with DSpark aborts the first large prefill:

```text
RuntimeError: Interleave CP gather received an unexpected local token count:
  rank=3, got=16, expected_at_least=4096, total=32768, cp_size=8
    .../srt/layers/cp/interleave.py:288 in _gather_interleaved_tensor
    .../srt/layers/cp/utils.py:246 in cp_gather_after_forward
    .../srt/model_executor/runner/eager_runner.py:405 in _execute_extend_cp
    .../srt/speculative/dspark_components/dspark_worker_v2.py:650 in _forward_prefill
```

With replay, the late layers run over each request's 128-token SWA tail; after
interleave sharding a rank owns 16 of those rows. `DeepseekV4Model.forward` puts
the tail rows back into the rank's full layout only when `not capture_dspark`.
With DSpark (`capture_dspark=True`) the model returns the 16 tail rows (and
tail-only aux tensors), `exit_late_layer_tail` has already restored the full-batch
CP metadata, and `_execute_extend_cp` then gathers with the full layout
(`32768 / 8 = 4096` expected rows per rank).

On CUDA, `deepseek_v4_hook.py` does not reject this combination at startup: its
incompatible list covers the prefill CUDA graph and DP attention, not prefill CP,
so a `DP=1 + CP=8` configuration passes the check and crashes at the first large
prefill. With this fix the combination is supported for **eager prefill**
(`--cuda-graph-backend-prefill disabled`); the breakable prefill CUDA graph with
prefill CP is guarded separately by #44141. On HIP, `validate_deepseek_v4_cp`
still rejects replay + CP until #43465 lands.

**Note for maintainers:** #43465 already carries the same tail-scatter block for
HIP, and #44730 builds on it. This PR is intentionally CUDA-only — the author of
#43465 has no NVIDIA hardware to validate this configuration. If you prefer to
land #43465 first, that is fine: merge it (and #44730 if it lands) and we will
rebase this branch on top. The two hunks touch the same lines and collapse into
one `is_cp_active` condition; this PR introduces no second design.

## Modifications

```diff
+def _needs_cp_tail_scatter(tail, forward_batch) -> bool:
+    return _is_cuda and tail is not None and is_cp_active(forward_batch)
...
-        if tail is not None and not capture_dspark:
+        cuda_cp_tail = _needs_cp_tail_scatter(tail, forward_batch)
+        if tail is not None and (not capture_dspark or cuda_cp_tail):
             ...
+            if cuda_cp_tail and capture_dspark:
+                dspark_aux_hidden_states = [
+                    _scatter_tail_rows(..., zero=True)
+                    for aux in dspark_aux_hidden_states
+                ]
```

- Add `_needs_cp_tail_scatter()` so the CUDA/CP gate is explicit and unit-testable.
- `_scatter_tail_rows(..., zero=False)` gains a zero-filled variant. The rows
  outside the tail are never read (`_check_late_layer_tail_readers`; DSpark's
  draft reads tail rows only), but the CP gather moves the whole rank layout, so
  they are zero-filled only as a defensive measure (the all-gather buffer stays
  finite); the fill can be dropped to match #43465 if preferred.
- Scatter `hidden_states`, `pre_hc_head` and every tail-layer DSpark aux tensor
  back into the rank layout before the CP gather. Both tensors are gathered:
  `cp_gather_after_forward` gathers the `(hidden_states, pre_hc_head)` tuple, and
  `pre_hc_head` is only dropped from the logits kwargs after the gather when aux
  is not `None`.
- Scoped to `_is_cuda`: this is the CUDA branch of the hunk already present in
  #43465/#44730. If either lands first, the rebase is one line (drop `_is_cuda`
  and keep `is_cp_active`).
- No CLI or config change: replay under CP still requires the explicit flag (the
  automatic resolution keeps it off).
- Unit test covers `_scatter_tail_rows` (indexed and contiguous tails) and
  `_needs_cp_tail_scatter` (CUDA/CP/tail truth table). The forward path itself is
  covered by the H20 run.

## Accuracy Tests

8×H20-3e (SM90), sglang v0.5.22 + this patch. 5 fixed prompts, temperature 0,
2 runs each:

| Comparison | Result |
| --- | --- |
| CP + DSpark + replay vs non-CP production (replay on) | 5/5 token-identical |

The CP run had block verification off while the baseline had it on, so the 5/5
match covers more than the CP-only difference. The C2bv A/B shows block
verification changes cold TTFT by only +0.2–0.5%.

The new CPU unit tests pass 4/4 on a CPU-only v0.5.22 image with the same
helper/scatter code mounted.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Cold TTFT, unique random prefix per request (2 runs each, spread ≤0.03 s):

| Config | 128K | 256K | 512K |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| CP + DSpark, replay off | 5.405 s | 11.710 s | 28.664 s |
| CP + DSpark + replay (this patch) | **3.369 s** | **6.864 s** | **15.954 s** |
| Speedup | 1.60× | 1.71× | 1.80× |

Decode replay, 36 real sessions, 256 output tokens (3–4 of the 36 runs do not
complete in each config; throughput counts completed sessions):

| Config | c1 ITL p50 | c8 ITL p50 | c8 output throughput |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Non-CP production, replay on (single run) | 11.8 ms | 23.9 ms | 149.3 tok/s |
| CP + DSpark, replay off (single run) | 18.4 ms | 27.4 ms | 176.0 tok/s |
| CP + DSpark + replay (c8 median of 5; c1 from C2bv #1) | 18.4 ms | 27.9 ms | **241.4 tok/s** |

The c1 ITL increase comes from CP decode, not from this change: it is the same
18.4 ms with replay off. c8 ITL p90 is noisy on this workload (157–386 ms across
5 runs), so p50 and throughput are the stable metrics. The replay-off decode
baseline is a single run; treat the +37% as directional.

Repro command:

```bash
sglang serve --model-path <DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash> --tp 8 --ep 4 \
  --enable-prefill-cp --cp-strategy interleave \
  --enable-decoder-swa-bounded-replay \
  --speculative-algorithm DSPARK \
  --speculative-dspark-block-size 5 \
  --cuda-graph-backend-prefill disabled \
  --chunked-prefill-size 32768 \
  --max-running-requests 12 \
  --mem-fraction-static 0.75
```

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way — revert the commit; no persisted state or schema changes.

**Blast radius:** one model file plus one CPU unit test, gated on
`_is_cuda and tail is not None and is_cp_active(forward_batch)`; the DSpark aux
branch additionally requires `capture_dspark`. Non-CP, HIP and decode paths are
untouched; CP without DSpark now zero-fills non-tail rows, which are never read.

Validation scope: the server numbers above come from v0.5.22 with the same
change, `PP=1`. The patch applies cleanly to `main` at `bd5a445` and the touched
code path is unchanged, but the full server has not been re-run on `main`.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the pre-commit guide.
- [x] Add unit tests (CPU tests included).
- [ ] Update documentation (not needed for this bug fix).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results.
- [x] Follow the code style guidance.

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the
   [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS)
   and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with
   [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests)
   or contact authorized users to do so. Common commands include
   `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`.
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write
   permission to merge the PR.

files.patch:
@@ -3528,8 +3528,16 @@ def _gather_late_layer_ids(
     return gathered.squeeze(-1)
 
 
+def _needs_cp_tail_scatter(
+    tail: Optional[LateLayerTail], forward_batch: ForwardBatch
+) -> bool:
+    """CUDA prefill CP with a replay tail: the CP gather reads this rank's full
+    layout, so the tail rows go back even when DSpark captures."""
+    return _is_cuda and tail is not None and is_cp_active(forward_batch)
+
+
 def _scatter_tail_rows(
-    tail: LateLayerTail, rows: torch.Tensor, num_tokens: int
+    tail: LateLayerTail, rows: torch.Tensor, num_tokens: int, zero: bool = False
 ) -> torch.Tensor:
     # Rows outside the tail are never read (see _check_late_layer_tail_readers).
     if tail.scatter_indices is not None:
@@ -3538,7 +3546,14 @@ def _scatter_tail_rows(
         full = rows.new_zeros((num_tokens + 1, rows.shape[1]))
         full.index_copy_(0, tail.scatter_indices, rows)
         return full[:num_tokens]
-    full = rows.new_empty((num_tokens, rows.shape[1]))
+    # CP gathers this rank's whole layout. The rows outside the tail are never
+    # read (see _check_late_layer_tail_readers); zeroing is defensive so the
+    # all-gather buffer stays finite.
+    full = (
+        rows.new_zeros((num_tokens, rows.shape[1]))
+        if zero
+        else rows.new_empty((num_tokens, rows.shape[1]))
+    )
     if tail.contiguous_start is not None:
         full[tail.contiguous_start :].copy_(rows)
     else:
@@ -4595,15 +4610,35 @@ def _forward_impl(
             )
         hidden_states = self.norm(hidden_states)
 
-        if tail is not None and not capture_dspark:
+        # CUDA prefill CP: the runner gathers every output, DSpark captures
+        # included, by this rank's full shard layout, so the tail rows go back
+        # into that layout before the gather.
+        cuda_cp_tail = _needs_cp_tail_scatter(tail, forward_batch)
+        if tail is not None and (not capture_dspark or cuda_cp_tail):
             # The logits processor indexes rows by the full extend layout.
             num_tokens = input_ids.shape[0]
             hidden_states = _scatter_tail_rows(
-                tail=tail, rows=hidden_states, num_tokens=num_tokens
+                tail=tail,
+                rows=hidden_states,
+                num_tokens=num_tokens,
+                zero=cuda_cp_tail,
             )
             pre_hc_head = _scatter_tail_rows(
-                tail=tail, rows=pre_hc_head, num_tokens=num_tokens
-            )
+                tail=tail,
+                rows=pre_hc_head,
+                num_tokens=num_tokens,
+                zero=cuda_cp_tail,
+            )
+            if cuda_cp_tail and capture_dspark:
+                dspark_aux_hidden_states = [
+                    _scatter_tail_rows(
+                        tail=tail,
+                        rows=aux,
+                        num_tokens=num_tokens,
+                        zero=True,
+                    )
+                    for aux in dspark_aux_hidden_states
+                ]
 
         if capture_dspark:
             return (hidden_states, pre_hc_head), dspark_aux_hidden_states.finalize()

+import unittest
+from unittest import mock
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.srt.layers.attention.deepseek_v4_backend import LateLayerTail
+from sglang.srt.models import deepseek_v4
+from sglang.srt.models.deepseek_v4 import _needs_cp_tail_scatter, _scatter_tail_rows
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=3, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+
+def _tail(**overrides):
+    fields = dict(
+        token_indices=torch.tensor([1, 3]),
+        positions=torch.tensor([1, 3]),
+        extend_seq_lens=torch.tensor([4]),
+        extend_seq_lens_cpu=[4],
+        swa_out_cache_loc=torch.tensor([1, 3]),
+    )
+    fields.update(overrides)
+    return LateLayerTail(**fields)
+
+
+class TestScatterTailRows(unittest.TestCase):
+    def test_zero_fills_rows_outside_the_tail(self):
+        out = _scatter_tail_rows(
+            _tail(), torch.tensor([[10.0], [20.0]]), num_tokens=4, zero=True
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(tuple(out.shape), (4, 1))
+        self.assertEqual(out[1, 0].item(), 10.0)
+        self.assertEqual(out[3, 0].item(), 20.0)
+        self.assertEqual(out[[0, 2]].abs().sum().item(), 0.0)
+
+    def test_zero_fills_rows_before_a_contiguous_tail(self):
+        out = _scatter_tail_rows(
+            _tail(contiguous_start=2), torch.tensor([[10.0], [20.0]]), 4, zero=True
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(out[:2].abs().sum().item(), 0.0)
+        self.assertTrue(torch.equal(out[2:], torch.tensor([[10.0], [20.0]])))
+
+    def test_default_keeps_the_existing_path(self):
+        out = _scatter_tail_rows(_tail(), torch.tensor([[10.0], [20.0]]), num_tokens=4)
+        self.assertEqual(out[1, 0].item(), 10.0)
+        self.assertEqual(out[3, 0].item(), 20.0)
+
+
+class TestNeedsCpTailScatter(unittest.TestCase):
+    def _check(self, *, cuda, cp, tail):
+        with (
+            mock.patch.object(deepseek_v4, "_is_cuda", cuda),
+            mock.patch.object(deepseek_v4, "is_cp_active", return_value=cp),
+        ):
+            return _needs_cp_tail_scatter(tail, object())
+
+    def test_requires_cuda_cp_and_a_tail(self):
+        tail = _tail()
+        self.assertTrue(self._check(cuda=True, cp=True, tail=tail))
+        self.assertFalse(self._check(cuda=False, cp=True, tail=tail))
+        self.assertFalse(self._check(cuda=True, cp=False, tail=tail))
+        self.assertFalse(self._check(cuda=True, cp=True, tail=None))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main(verbosity=2)

`lint` and the PR-title check are green on the new head. The only red jobs are the `pr-gate` ones, because the PR has no `run-ci` label, which I can't add.

The fix is still missing upstream: `python/sglang/srt/models/deepseek_v4.py` still has `if tail is not None and not capture_dspark:` at the late-layer scatter. With prefill CP + decoder SWA replay + DSpark the late layers return only the per-rank SWA tail (16 rows), while `_eager_runner._execute_extend_cp` gathers this rank's full shard layout (4096 rows per rank), so the first large prefill aborts with `Interleave CP gather received an unexpected local token count`. The patch scatters `hidden_states`, `pre_hc_head` and the DSpark aux tensors back into the CP layout on CUDA and zero-fills the non-tail rows; HIP stays untouched (#43465 still rejects replay + CP).
